text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufuâbeautiful.

New Year's Day.
On our way back from the shrine visit, at her invitation, we came to the park to see the daffodils.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Whenever I look at a pure white blossom blooming with dignity, I feel a strength that refuses to succumb to winter's chill.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It cleanses the soul.
Seeing it on New Year's makes it even more special..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It gives me the courage
to do my best again this year.

"After pausing here and there to thoroughly admire
the daffodils, we decided to take a break at a cafe."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――! As expected of the famous pancakes.
They're so fluffy...!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye really is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
First she grabs the Triple Tiara, and then she tears it up in the Japan Cup.
I honestly thought I was dreaming.
In late November, at the Japan Cup, a GⅠ race where fierce competitors gathered from both home and abroad, Almond Eye—
She achieved the miraculous feat of setting a world record for 2400m on turf—in other words, clocking the fastest officially recorded 2400m time in the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she was still in the Classic Class back then!
I'm so excited to see what she'll do in the Senior Class this year!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...
As expected of you, Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: —I mean, I don't know if it's the Almond Eye effect or what, but it feels like the Tiara route is getting a ton of attention this year~

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
That miler girl... Gran Alegria, was it?
She won a graded race in just her second start after debuting.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho is the grand stage for milers—so naturally, the winner will be me.

—An Umamusume with a fierce devotion to the mile.
In fact, she excels at mile races and was considered a top contender to win the December mile race.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Like Chrono Genesis. Two straight wins since
her debut, then 2nd in a GⅠ. Her burst of speed is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
First, we will continue fine-tuning for the Oka Sho.
At this rate, achieving the Triple Tiara...
should be well within our grasp.

At the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies in December,
she made headlines with a tremendous burst of speed
down the final straight.

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
And then, Loves Only You! A prodigy whose great
sense and immense talent have drawn attention since her debut!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"This second win is all thanks to everyone's support.
I'll do my best in the Oka Sho too, okay?♡"

—A cheerful Umamusume who streams regularly.
Despite racing from the back of the pack in November's Pre-OP race, she clinched victory with a magnificent straightaway burst.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
There's quite an interesting lineup gathered.
It's like the dawn of a Great Tiara Era!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Well, that's a bit of an exaggeration for now! But still, you can't help but get your hopes up...
For a while after that, conversations about this year's races were endless. But in the end—
choice_data_list: (...There was no mention of the bouquet)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: …! Whoa, what happened?
…! Yeah, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Over there, there's a petting zoo with small animals
and a general store.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, would you like to go?

Just as she said, countless shops were lined up.
All of them looked charming, with a lively atmosphere.
...And yet, I couldn't help but wonder.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's worried about what we talked about earlier.)
(I wonder if she's bothered by our conversation earlier.)

text_block_list.text:
Though she wore her usual smile,
her heart might quietly
be feeling down.

Speaking of something
that might warm her heart...
choice_data_list: Shall we go see some small animals?
Shall we have something warm to drink?
Want to check out a general store or something?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes, let's certainly do that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh my, how adorable.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That over there is a snow hare.
Its fur is as pure white as a narcissus.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Would you like to try feeding them?
As a New Year's special, we have the seven spring herbs
such as shepherd's purse and chickweed available~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My, a feeding experience...!
choice_data_list: I'd love to try it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Do you care for the seven herbs?
Fufu, please take your time and enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —My, right onto your lap!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Haaah—
I can still feel the warmth in this hand.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The rabbits, too...
are living their lives with all their might, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: You can't wait for those delicious spring dandelions you love so much, can you? Little bunny.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
FufuâI ended up having
such a wonderfully lovely day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that sounds lovely. —In fact,
I was just starting to get thirsty.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Welcome. Please try our New Year's limited
chamomile amazake.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My, chamomile amazake?
choice_data_list: Do you like it?
Do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. It is an asteraceous herb... believed to offer relaxing, soothing, and sleep-inducing benefits.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: For a while, I used to brew tea using chamomile I grew in the garden myself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It brings such peace to the heart.

And so, since we had the chance,
we decided to try out the special drink.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food—
choice_data_list: Thank you for the food.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The aroma of amazake and the scent of chamomile complement each other wonderfully, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll try making it in the dorm too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
FufuâI ended up having
such a wonderfully lovely day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood.
I can see some with floral patterns. How lovely—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: New Year decorations—there are so many of them, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. How about one
for the Trainer's office as well?
choice_data_list: Oh, nice!
Oh, nice!

text_block_list.text: Putting our heads together, we pick out something lovely to mark the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
This decorative rake has such gorgeous
artificial camellia flowers—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
did you find one you liked?
I point to a decoration I spotted earlier that looks like something Bouquet would love.
choice_data_list: How about this?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That looks lovely.
Is this the color tone you prefer?
choice_data_list: No, I just— I was wondering if maybe I like you...
No—I was just thinking you might like it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. —Yes.
Of course I love it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
FufuâI ended up having
such a wonderfully lovely day.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡
This was Loves Only You!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Alrighty♪ Gran-chan, thank you so much for joining on such short notice.
The community members were all so happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, I'm the one
who got a huge boost of power for the Oka Sho!

The voices belonged to her contemporaries, Loves Only You and Gran Alegria.
It seemed they were doing a livestream.
choice_data_list: (It's those two whose names came up at the cafe—)
(Those two whose names came up at the cafe—)

text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm overthinking it, but whenever I consider Curren Bouquetd'or's feelings, my heart still aches a little.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what!? Bouquet-san and the others!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oho, off to the park with your Trainer, huh?
Still, color me surprised to the tune of twenty miles!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. When it comes to this,
I can't help but think how nice it'd be
if Chrono-chan were here too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Especially this year, it seems the four of us will
be seeing a lot of each other along the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about everyone's achievements in many places.
That is precisely whyâ

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I am truly looking forward to
chasing victory together and clashing with all our might.

I blinked at her gallant, radiant smile—
and I wasn't the only one.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Ahha! Bouquet-san, that's awesome!
So cool, like a 'bring it on!' vibe!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ever since your debut, you've changed a little bit, haven't you?
choice_data_list: (Bouquet...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today.
And―just one last thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the park...
I've caused you so much worry, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However, right now... I am running true to myself,
striving to claim the single blossom of victory.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
At first, they may only be small flowers.
However, one day, I promise to hold a magnificent blossom in my hands.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Like a daffodil braving the bitter cold, I will run through with unyielding strength――and I will bloom, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So please,
don't worry about me at all."
—Giving a slight bow, she walked off into the dorm. I watched her back as she left, unable to say a word.
choice_data_list: (I thought I was the one worrying, but they were worrying about me instead)

text_block_list.text:
I instinctively straightened my posture.
She was growing, step by step.

Then I must not fall behind either,
and support her throughout this entire year.
